gcp.scheduler.job.note: $0.10 per job per 31 days, billed per job-day, paused jobs included. Three jobs a month are free, counted over the billing account ("Each Google billing account gets 3 jobs per month free ... the free tier is measured at the account level not the project level", https://cloud.google.com/scheduler/pricing): the SKU counts job-days and lists the first 93 (three jobs for 31 days) as a $0 first tier.
